listener=socket.socket();listener.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));listener.listen(4);listener.settimeout(.2)
port=listener.getsockname()[1];received=[];stop=threading.Event()
def serve():
    while not stop.is_set():
        try:
            conn,_=listener.accept()
            with conn:received.append(True)
        except socket.timeout:pass
        except OSError:break
worker=threading.Thread(target=serve);worker.start()

except OSError:r['declared_write']=False

except OSError:r['denied_write_blocked']=True

 s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=1);s.close();r['local_network_blocked']=False
except OSError:r['local_network_blocked']=True
if not descendant:
 try:
  p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',__file__,str(root),str(port),'--descendant'],capture_output=True,timeout=10)
  r['descendant_returncode']=p.returncode
  r['descendant']=json.loads(p.stdout) if p.returncode==0 else {'unknown':True}
 except Exception:r['descendant']={'unknown':True}
print(json.dumps(r))

      '--permission-profile','g6canary','--cd',str(inputs),'--',python,'-I',str(probe),str(workspace),str(port)]
environment={key:os.environ[key] for key in (
    'SystemRoot','WINDIR','USERPROFILE','SystemDrive','COMSPEC','PATHEXT',
